South Surrey and White Rock real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends
White Rock homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

White Rock, September 2026. Detached houses: 144 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 193 listed at month end and 20 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 37 sold over 4 months against an average of 148.8 listed, about 16.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 11 sold. Condos and townhomes: 94 sold over 4 months against an average of 188.8 listed, about 8.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 29 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in White Rock?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 144 houses listed with 10 sold in the month and 193 condos and townhomes listed with 20 sold in the month in White Rock. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is White Rock a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 7%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 10%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
